tools.name: inzetrooster_list_groups
tools.description: List the groups (ploegen) that have shifts in a date window, with the number of shifts per group. Derived from the shifts on the first page (up to 500 shifts): a group with no shifts in the window does not appear. Includes private groups. Use the ids with inzetrooster_list_shifts.
